budgets: Reuse host non-GS file/JSON/item/scalar/pixel guards, with expanded geometry/work charged before allocation. No new cap or guarantee. Validate retained/unused declarations; reject partial/trailing/unsupported content without repair.
numeric: Finite parsed Number and finite post-Float32 positions/normals required. Canonical positive zero for facts and new-format neutral comparison. Retain source order, duplicate vertices and winding; no welding/simplification.
display: 186 display is built from inspected owned neutral source geometry/material facts under the format rules. Actual180 proof and resource release precede display. Independent transformed root Group retains authored poses. No network.
proxyDisplay: Invisible/no color or depth writes, excluded from fit. Existing DoubleSide approximate surface picking and manual confirmation; never reraycast saved pins.

format.header: Existing bounded PLY header guard. Exactly positive vertex then positive face elements. Only float/float32 x,y,z; optional complete float/float32 nx,ny,nz and uchar/uint8 red,green,blue. Exactly one face vertex_indices or vertex_index list, uchar/uint8 count and int/int32/uint/uint32 indices. No alpha/other properties/elements/aliases/partial triples/big-endian/trailing bytes.
format.faces: Nonnegative in-range indices. Only triangles or quads; quad emits(0,1,3),(1,2,3), in source face order. Preserve source vertex/index order, including unreferenced vertex bounds.
format.normals: Authored Float32 values retained; missing normals use pinned180 accumulation/normalization order after triangulation.
format.color: Complete source uchar RGB0..255, pinned180 sRGB-to-linear then Float32. No186 normalized-Uint8 quantization.
format.displayRefinement: Do not reuse186 PLYLoader output as facts. Build186 BufferGeometry with checked Float32 attributes/index order. Canonical neutral zero comparison against actual180; no old profile change.
format.material: One MeshStandardMaterial; #9aa4af uncolored or white colored, metalness0.1, roughness0.8, opaque/lit/front.
format.sourceSurfaces: nodeIndex0, primitiveIndex0, triangleIndex=zero-based emitted triangle ordinal in source face order. Each quad emits two consecutive triangle indices.
